    "Initial learning curve was somewhat overwhelming",
    "Lack of an auto-save feature can be frustrating",
    "Copy/paste functionality can be inconsistent"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Director found Smartsheet to be a significant upgrade from Excel for managing project pipelines in their e-learning company. While the initial learning curve was a bit steep, the robust functionality and dashboard capabilities greatly simplified their oversight tasks. They appreciated its reliability but noted minor frustrations with basic features like copy/paste and the absence of auto-save."
